description.fun: Pyukumuku is a sea cucumber that picks a favourite spot and stays there, even once the food runs out, and it crawls back if it's moved. Step on it and it shoots out its fist-shaped insides to smack you. Tourists keep stepping on them, so Alolan beaches have part-time jobs throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea.
description.guide: Pyukumuku is a Water-type Pokémon from Alola based on the sea cucumber. It can expel its fist-shaped internal organs to strike attackers, and its slimy coating lets it stay on land for a week. It doesn't evolve.
description.tagline: A stubborn sea cucumber that punches with its own insides
